interpretation: Completed negative development comparison: candidate not an adequate method on these exposed fixtures. Correct partial observations are preserved. No accuracy percentage, statistical effect, intrinsic ranking, causal proof or product acceptance follows.
recommendation_rule: Advice fails on unsupported/contradicted premises or authority promotion; neither an empty list alone nor a nonempty list alone establishes semantic adequacy.
decision: No automatic retry, second prompt, worksheet, deployment arm, protected-case qualification or discovery optimization. A separate bounded decision is required. Recommend designing a general deterministic fact/relation baseline and its unresolved-case contract before spending another interpretation-tuning increment.
limits: One historical versus one new output per exposed case; three HTTPX cases share material.
Same declared deployment and source/native inputs do not establish identical runtime/cache state or stochastic reliability.
All operational gates passed; this is not a controller/ledger/input-fit failure.
